fields.description: The Alba Residences is OMNIYAT’s unfurnished residential collection on Palm Jumeirah. Zaha Hadid Architects designed the architecture, with landscaping by Vladimir Djurovic and services by Dorchester Collection. Simplex and duplex homes sit alongside larger super penthouses, with private outdoor space and access to the wider beachfront destination.
